**On-screen content:** Whiteboard showing the complete backtracking template with base cases and state restoration:

```java
solve(row, col ...) {
    if (col == board[row].length) {
        // Move to next row or handle final base case
    }
    
    for (int value = 1; value <= 9; value++) {
        board[row][col] = value;
        if (validPlacement(row, col ...)) {
            if (solve(row, col + 1, board)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        board[row][col] = EMPTY_ENTRY; // Backtrack / Undo decision
    }
}
```
